q: A model is intended to predict readmission at discharge. Which feature is a clear leakage risk?
options: Age at admission
Discharge disposition recorded after the prediction time
Admission blood pressure
Comorbidity count available at admission
why: A feature recorded after the index time would not be available when the prediction is made.

q: Which statement best distinguishes prediction from causal inference?
options: A predictive feature must be causal
Prediction estimates outcomes for new cases; causal inference estimates effects of interventions
High AUROC proves treatment benefit
Feature importance is a causal effect
why: Predictive association does not establish that intervening on a feature changes outcomes.
